artifact_observations.reasoning: There are faint, illegible white markings inside the red lens that resemble corrupted text or symbols ('W' shapes or similar). This is not a standard feature of traffic lights and suggests an AI artifact attempting to render detail or text.

The internal 'honeycomb' or grid patterns are highly irregular and inconsistent across the three lenses. The amber lens has a chaotic mesh, while the green has a radial burst pattern. Real traffic lenses usually have uniform Fresnel patterns or smooth diffusers. This inconsistency suggests generative variance rather than manufacturing precision.
The mounting bolts/lugs on the side of the housing appear slightly soft and inconsistently shaped. The top right bolt looks partially fused into the housing edge. Minor structural imprecision.
